tools.name: ncsx_curve
tools.description: The US Treasury par-yield curve used on the pricing date (14 tenors, interpolated linearly, never extrapolated) plus its recent history. Every constituent spread is measured against this curve.

tools.name: ncsx_sector
tools.description: Context series for the AI-infrastructure credit complex: US high-yield OAS, US investment-grade OAS and related ICE BofA indices, with 30-day change and daily history — use these to compare NCSX-IS against the broader market.

tools.description: Second, independent layer: quarterly fair-value marks for AI-infrastructure bonds as reported by US registered funds on SEC Form N-PORT (Level 2), converted to spread over the matched Treasury. Compare with NCSX-IS to see issuance spread vs. mark spread.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: ncsx_facts, ncsx_events, ncsx_ruler · Private data: ncsx_latest · Public sink: ncsx_wall, ncsx_stories, ncsx_facts, ncsx_events.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: ncsx_facts, ncsx_events, ncsx_ruler · Private data: ncsx_latest · Public sink: ncsx_wall, ncsx_stories, ncsx_facts, ncsx_events

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "ncsx_latest" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Get the latest NCSX index levels (Composite / HY / IG) with daily & weekly changes, 90-day percentiles, as-of date, methodology version, DOI and data_status. Read data_status before quoting: "seed" means demo series, "verified" means observed market data." → after: "The one number to quote — use this first for "what is NCSX-IS / what is the spread right now". Returns a compact record: headline issuance spread (coupon minus the Treasury yield of matching tenor on the pricing date, weighted by face value), the secured and unsecured sub-indices, constituent/issuer"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
